name: Lost Cosmonauts
source:
Stranded in space, haunted by the past. You are Nikolay – war survivor, engineer, father… now humanity's last hope. Fix the broken station – or vanish in the void.

[From [url=https://liyumine.itch.io/lost-cosmonauts]Itch.io[/url]]
